Class PlatformPreset

java.lang.Object
be.imgn.gaia.core.testing.PlatformPreset
public final class PlatformPreset extends Object
The system properties and environment variables a JVM typically has on an operating system, to detect a Platform from, so that tests run the real detection of the directories of any operating system: 
PlatformPreset windows = PlatformPreset.newBuilder(OperatingSystem.WINDOWS).userName("alice").build();
Platform platform = Platform.newBuilder()
        .systemProperties(windows.systemProperties())
        .environment(windows.environment())
        .fileSystem(fileSystem)
        .detect();

The user is test unless given, and their home directory is the default one for that user, unless given. With user test, the system properties are:

System properties
PropertyLinuxOther UnixmacOSWindows
os.nameLinuxFreeBSDMac OS X Windows 11
os.version6.8.014.1-RELEASE15.0 10.0
os.archamd64amd64aarch64 amd64
user.nametest
user.home, user.dir/home/test/home/test /Users/testC:\Users\test
java.io.tmpdir/tmp/tmp/tmp C:\Users\test\AppData\Local\Temp\
file.separator///\
path.separator:::;
line.separator\n\n\n \r\n

The environment variables are:

  • Linux, other Unix, macOS: HOME (the home directory) and USER (the user name). No XDG variable is set, so the specification's defaults apply, unless PlatformPreset.Builder.xdgVariables(boolean) sets them.
  • Windows: USERNAME, USERPROFILE (the home directory), APPDATA (C:\Users\test\AppData\Roaming), LOCALAPPDATA (C:\Users\test\AppData\Local), TEMP and TMP (C:\Users\test\AppData\Local\Temp), ProgramData (C:\ProgramData), SystemDrive (C:) and SystemRoot (C:\Windows). Their names are case-sensitive, unlike on a real Windows.

The values are strings, which the platform turns into paths of the file system it is given. Give it a file system of the same kind as the operating system to get the same paths as on that system: on a Unix file system, for example, a Windows path such as C:\Users\test is a relative path with a single name. The detected paths are still consistent, so a test can compare them with paths it builds on the same file system, the same way.

Before 0.1.2, it was be.imgn.gaia.platform.testing.PlatformPreset, in its own module, gaia-platform-testing.
